briefdescription.para: Initializes an IPI instance from a given configuration record.

parameterdescription.para: Device configuration structure containing the required hardware build data.
Base address of the device. If address translation is not used, pass CfgPtr->BaseAddress to specify the physical base address.

briefdescription.para: Resets the given IPI register set.

detaileddescription.para: Disables the IPIs from all sources and clears any pending IPIs in the status register.

briefdescription.para: Triggers an IPI to a destination CPU.

parameterdescription.para: Mask of the CPU to which the IPI is triggered.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS after the trigger register is written.

briefdescription.para: Polls for an acknowledgment using the observation register.

parameterdescription.para: Mask of the destination CPU from which the acknowledgment is expected.
Count after which the routine returns failure.

memberdef.argsstring: (XIpiPsu *InstancePtr, u32 SrcCpuMask, u32 *MsgPtr, u32 MsgLength, u8 BufferType)
memberdef.name: XIpiPsu_ReadMessage

briefdescription.para: Reads an incoming message from a source.

parameterdescription.para: Device mask for the CPU that sent the message.
Buffer that receives the read message. Must not be NULL and must hold at least MsgLength words.
Number of words to read (each word is 4 bytes). Must not exceed XIPIPSU_MAX_MSG_LEN.

listitem.para: XIPIPSU_CRC_ERROR if the CRC check fails (when CRC is enabled).
XST_FAILURE if the buffer address is not valid.

memberdef.argsstring: (XIpiPsu *InstancePtr, u32 DestCpuMask, const u32 *MsgPtr, u32 MsgLength, u8 BufferType)
memberdef.name: XIpiPsu_WriteMessage

briefdescription.para: Sends a message to a destination.

parameterdescription.para: Device mask for the destination CPU.
Buffer that contains the message to send. Must not be NULL and must hold at least MsgLength words.
Number of words to send (each word is 4 bytes). Must not exceed XIPIPSU_MAX_MSG_LEN.

listitem.para: XST_FAILURE if the buffer address is not valid.
